thesis: FX and funding bridges are absent, so neither can establish recurring shareholder cash economics. Stable dividends and revenue do not resolve the dispute.
strongest_counterexample: Growing revenue and an unchanged 25-sen dividend preserve a resilient utility case despite FX-affected earnings.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive FCF and positive FX-adjusted operating-profit growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining FX-adjusted operating profit.
evidence_gaps: Operating-versus-FX reconciliation and capex recovery/funding coverage.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Revenue and maintained dividends support operating resilience
The FX explanation prevents blindly extrapolating headline profit weakness, but does not establish recurring cash earnings either
